content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences is located at Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029. This post is in an ICMR funded task force project titled "Establishing the cause in Sudden Unexplained Death in young", run under Dr. Sudhir K. Gupta, Professor and Head, Department of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, A.I.I.M.S., New Delhi. The notice was issued on 11 November 2026 in English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Nationality: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. Educational qualification: High School or equivalent and above. Age limit: 18-25 years. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. Age relaxation: Age relaxation will be as per Government rules. The notice does not ask for any experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Attendant/Multi-Tasking staff post carries a pay of Rs. 17,900/month. The engagement is for 10 months in the ICMR funded project, and the notice says this period may be extendable. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this pay.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice allows two ways to apply. Applications are accepted from 11 November 2026 to 25 November 2026. Prepare your application with a detailed CV and your certificates. Send it as an e-mail to [email protected] . Or send it via post, or hand it in person, to Room no: 311, Office of the Head of the Department, Department of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, A.I.I.M.S., Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 29. Application Detailed CV Certificates The notice does not prescribe an application form format or an e-mail subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted, and only short-listed candidates will be informed about the interview via phone/e-mail. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The notice does not give an interview date.
